'''Assid Bakuun''' is a [[captain]] in the [[Seanchan]] army. He has served in the army for thirty years.

==Activities==
He leads a Seanchan unit against one of [[Rand al'Thor]]'s armies just outside [[Illian]]. The [[Asha'man]] attack the Seanchan and it is unknown if he survives.
